claims.exact_wording: The evaluated complex operator has an exact structured real-block implementation that reproduces its top-1 predictions at numerical precision.
evidence: QN-000033 mapped mechanism runs differ by at most approximately 4.8e-7 across recorded metrics.
QN-000042 complex and exact-real top-1 are identical in all 1,920 held-out nested cells; maximum NLL difference is 3.58e-7.
counterevidence: This does not imply that every complex-valued architecture or optimization trajectory is equivalent to every unconstrained real network.
Different parameterizations can impose different inductive biases even when the represented mapped function is the same.
claims.uncertainty: Deterministic mapped equivalence plus floating-point tolerance; not a population estimate.
claims.external_validity: Algebraic mapping is general; empirical tolerance was tested only in this codebase.
claims.novelty_status: Known algebraic representation applied as a stringent project control.
claims.replication_status: Internally repeated across mechanism discovery and four held-out task families; no independent team replication.
claims.falsifier: A mapped forward, loss, gradient, or prediction comparison exceeding the frozen numerical tolerance.

claims.exact_wording: Within the reduced independent-task studies, the cellwise best-real envelope removes the observed complex robustness advantage.
evidence: QN-000040 has zero positive complex-minus-best-real effects among 2,880 nested discovery cells.
QN-000042 has zero positive effects among 1,920 held-out nested cells and a family/world/seed hierarchical mean of -0.00916 with 95% interval [-0.01325, -0.00457].
counterevidence: The independent discovery and confirmation profiles are outcome-ineligible and compute-reduced.
The complete 14-model real envelope and full ShiftGauntlet outcome grid were not run.
assumptions: best-real selection is cellwise and prespecified
claims.scope: Four held-out and four discovery synthetic nonmedical generator families under the reduced profile
claims.external_validity: Unknown beyond the implemented synthetic generators.
claims.novelty_status: Negative empirical result; priority not claimed.
claims.replication_status: Direction repeats in pilot, discovery, and held-out reduced confirmation; no external replication.
claims.falsifier: A fully preregistered clean run in which the complex-minus-best-real aggregate is positive and its adjusted interval exceeds +0.02.

claims.exact_wording: The frozen quadratic relationship selected on reduced discovery data fails quantitative prediction on held-out task families.
evidence: QN-LAW-001 discovery R2 is 0.949 with MAE 0.00260 across 12 aggregate cells.
QN-000042 held-out R2 is -30.94 and MAE 0.0313; the frozen requirements were R2 at least 0.50 and MAE at most 0.015.
counterevidence: Effect-sign accuracy is 1.0 because all observed and predicted gaps are non-positive.
claims.uncertainty: Twelve held-out family-by-severity aggregates; no refitting permitted.
claims.falsifier: Not applicable after prospective failure; a new law requires a new preregistration and split.

claims.exact_wording: The earlier positive NeuroWorld result is comparator-dependent rather than evidence of intrinsically complex arithmetic.
evidence: QN-000008 reports +0.0602 moderate-shift top-1 versus a two-channel real control.
Later exact-real and best-real comparisons reverse the sign in QN-000031, QN-000040, and QN-000042.
counterevidence: The later studies use different generator families and reduced profiles, so the four point estimates are not one meta-analysis.
assumptions: comparator identity is stated with every estimate
claims.scope: Interpretation of the QN-000008 within-simulator result
claims.replication_status: Historical result replicated within NeuroWorld; intrinsic interpretation refuted by stronger controls.
claims.falsifier: A same-task parameter/compute-matched study in which complex exceeds the exact-real and strongest structured-real controls.

claims.exact_wording: QN-GRAND-001 did not execute and provides no primary confirmatory effect estimate.
evidence: The registered preflight records six blocking failures and sealed_benchmark_opened=false.
counterevidence: Eight readiness checks passed, including the shortcut gate, power plan, exact-real equivalence, and held-out family separation.
assumptions: Any failed mandatory gate blocks sealed access
claims.falsifier: Artifact evidence that all gates passed and the sealed benchmark was executed, which does not exist.

claims.exact_wording: The repository contains no evidence of clinical validity, patient benefit, safety, or a quantum mechanism of cognition.
evidence: All next-phase tasks are synthetic and nonclinical; no patient dataset was selected or evaluated.
claims.uncertainty: This is a scope statement, not an efficacy estimate.
claims.falsifier: A separately approved and preregistered clinical validation program with valid patient evidence.
